# LOL梗 (LOLgeng)

> LOLgeng (www.lolgeng.com) collects funny internet memes from China and around the world, one interactive page per meme. Homepages: Chinese at https://www.lolgeng.com/ and English at https://www.lolgeng.com/en/.

## Memes

- [疯狂星期四 Crazy Thursday](https://www.lolgeng.com/event): China's weekly "Crazy Thursday / V me 50" KFC meme, with a countdown to the next Thursday and animated effects (page in Chinese).
